blurb: Sometimes the best home service providers come from a neighbor's recommendation, and Happy Floor LLC is exactly that kind of find. Based in Marietta, this flooring contractor has built a reputation on two things that are surprisingly hard to find at the same time: quality work and genuine responsiveness. One customer reached out on a Thursday needing an installation done by Saturday, and Happy Floor made it happen, quick estimate and all. Another had a full home flooring project completed and walked away genuinely pleased with both the work and the punctuality. Those aren't throwaway compliments, those are the details that actually matter when you're living through a home project. If you've been putting off that flooring upgrade because you're dreading the process of finding someone reliable, this one is worth a call. They've got a perfect five-star rating across their reviews, which for a contractor in this area is harder to maintain than it looks. Word-of-mouth built this business, and the word around East Cobb is pretty clear.
scoring_notes: Strong fit for homeowner audience with a perfect rating and responsive service story, though the review count is thin at only 9 reviews.
